performance_case.causal_mechanism: A post-shock strategy claim is causal only when the terminal discovery result and semantic Manager review are hash-bound before untouched future evidence, decision availability is the exact maximum of artifact clocks, and a deterministic later fill observation is independently bound rather than borrowed from the discovery response.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive implementation proves only a closed parent-neutral actionability schema, pure builder/validator, synthetic timing/hash tests and bounded documentation. It cannot prove a real terminal factor, actual latency, strategy direction, parent or adapter compatibility, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS, deployment or Trading value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Drawdown and path risk remain MISSING_PROOF until a separately frozen parent, adapter, capital, fee, slippage and economic ledger consume genuinely untouched post-activation evidence.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The four-file offline slice prevents t0-to-h24 discovery leakage and incompatible DRA adapter reuse before candidate budget is spent. Its cost is delaying strategy specification until a later real terminal factor and causal fill record exist.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This slice cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL. Its research value is making later positive factor evidence actionable without lookahead by freezing exact availability and point-in-time fill identities before any strategy or economic evaluation is selected.
